name: Kesar Petroproducts Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1990, Kesar Petroproducts Ltd manufactures and markets Organic Chemicals and Pigments[1]
keyPoints:
Industry Position[1]
The company is a leading Indian manufacturer of pigments, specializing in Phthalocyanine Blue Crude and its downstream derivatives, with a 15% market share in India.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 42.1% CAGR over last 5 years
Debtor days have improved from 59.8 to 46.8 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.37% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 3.79% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
